title: Compliance rows show the record; meterless services flag a reading
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Your user also holds "Settings Service" to seed the schedule.
  3. Schedule "Highway Tractor PM" (standard seeding steps) with: PM-A (Every 3 months + Distance Every 15,000 mileage); CVIP (compliance, Type "CVIP", Term 12 months); "Federal Annual Inspection" (compliance, Term 12 months); "Engine overhaul" (calendar Every 12 months + Distance "At" 250,000); "Winter prep" (calendar "At" 15 Nov).
  4. Asset A: an asset with no mileage reading on file (its asset card shows no Mileage). On its asset card Compliance section click + Add record: Type CVIP, Term 12 months, End date 14 Oct 2026, Certificate number AB-4471902; Save.
  5. Asset B: an asset whose asset card shows a Mileage above 250,000 (e.g. 342,417).
custom_steps:
1. On asset A click Enroll in Schedule, pick "Highway Tractor PM" and read the CVIP row and the Federal Annual Inspection row.
  2. Read the PM-A row on asset A.
  3. On asset B open the modal, pick the schedule and read the Engine overhaul row and its default choice.
  4. Enroll asset A; read Winter prep's due date on its Maintenance tab.
  5. Hover the (i) beside the "Needs mileage reading" badge.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The CVIP row shows the record's number and End date ("AB-4471902 · ends 14 Oct 2026"); Federal Annual Inspection shows that it has no record, with + Add record.
  • PM-A carries the badge "Needs mileage reading", and its calendar date still shows.
  • Engine overhaul shows that 250,000 has already been passed and offers "Mark as done" or "Leave due"; "Mark as done" is chosen by default.
  • Winter prep comes due on its next 15 Nov: this year if today is before 15 Nov (e.g. enrolled 6 Oct 2026 -> Nov 2026), otherwise next year.
  • On the design the (i) reads "Each meter is judged on its own: a service measured from mileage and one measured from engine hours never share a badge."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S7 (A compliance service in that list; Where the first cycle starts; S7-R6, S7-R15, S7-E1, S7-E2); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 6 Phase P2, frontend table (EnrolmentServiceRow); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard X1r; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R6: “A compliance service will show its existing record's number and End date, or No record with + Add record”
  • S7-R15: “Where a service watches a meter that has no usable readings, its row carries a badge naming the meter, Needs mileage reading or Needs engine hours reading”
  • S7-E1: “A meter "At" that has already been passed at enrolment shows what happened and offers Mark as done or Leave due. The default is done”
  • S7-E2: “A calendar "At" takes its next occurrence, counting today if that day has not passed”
  • Plan 1 §6 P2 EnrolmentServiceRow: “compliance record line "{number} · ends {endDate}" or "No record" + "+ Add record"”
  • Design board, artboard X1r (badge (i)): “Each meter is judged on its own: a service measured from mileage and one measured from engine hours never share a badge.”
